svg.title: Each final file is a fixed-weight mix of two student pools and two branches; pick 1 gives the popularity-light pool 0.4 on short feeds and 0.2 on long ones

cc:Work.dc:title: Each final file is a fixed-weight mix of two student pools and two branches; pick 1 gives the popularity-light pool 0.4 on short feeds and 0.2 on long ones
cc:Work.dc:description: Box-and-arrow diagram. On the left, two groups, fine-tuned predictions and train-only predictions, each with a pool of 16 full-view students and a pool of 4 popularity-light students. In each group the two pools are mixed with weights 1 − w and w into a branch, w = 0.4 on feeds of fewer than 50 candidates and 0.2 on the others: validation NDCG 0.40139 for the fine-tuned branch and 0.40208 for the train-only branch. The branches are mixed 0.5 and 0.5 into the final score, validation NDCG 0.40293, which is ranked within each feed and written to the submission file of 2,904,806 rows.
